backup_destination: Owner-selected private backup directory outside Git, with enough free disk; preferably copy to a second drive. Do not commit PostgreSQL dumps, runtime environment or image exports.
git_evidence_backup: git-and-backup.json: verified local Git archive; original accepted evidence unchanged
raw_backup: Raw21+metadata are independent Windows files; verify hashes and keep a separate supplied bundle. They are never deletion targets.
order: Fresh exact-ID/ownership/volume-reference check against deletion-manifest.json; drift stops execution
Fresh no active/queued run/task/writer/query/lock gate; both DAGs paused
Optional pg_dump logical exports to private backup destination while DB is healthy, credentials read inside container only; verify pg_restore listing
One graceful signal/service: scheduler, webserver, idle Spark SIGINT, Trino, REST, MinIO, PostgreSQL. Never force or repeat on timeout
After all owners stopped, copy all listed persistent volumes (including anonymous owned mc-init volume) using existing container mount references

Inspect docker diff and catalog URI for container-only SQLite/metadata; export changed catalog/config/log files individually. Volumes are not included by docker export. Do not copy bind-source Raw as a deletion backup
Generate backup SHA256/file-count manifest and check readable data/catalog files; keep PG physical data with matching pinned image identity
Recheck stopped IDs and resource references; only then remove the exact approved containers, networks and volumes without force
Retain every bind directory, all unattributed resources and all images; build fresh canonical project only after cleanup and resource admission
